opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality, who are being forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death. Applications considered on a rolling basis.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission for academics in immediate danger, providing temporary refuge in universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) until they can return home. Fellowships help academics at risk to escape to a safe place where they can continue their work, either through postgraduate (PhD) study or postdoctoral research placements. Cara checks applications, helps negotiate placements, allocates additional funding, and assists with visas and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family members. Awards are typically 2- or 3-year placements.
